seo.metaTitle: Word to PDF converter — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Convert Word document text, contracts, or manuscripts into a clean, print-ready PDF file locally without uploading to cloud servers. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/word-to-pdf-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Word to PDF converter processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/word-to-pdf-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Word to PDF converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Word to PDF converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/word-to-pdf-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Word to PDF converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Word to PDF converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/word-to-pdf-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Word to PDF converter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/word_to_pdf.json or open /tools/word-to-pdf?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
